% Pattern: proof/amsthm/article. The proof is written inside the environment
% of its theorem, before \end{theorem}. It proves the theorem that holds it.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here labels=th:a
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1 parent=theorem-1 labels=eq:a
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}\label{th:a}
A statement.
\begin{proof}
A step with
\begin{equation}\label{eq:a}
x = y.
\end{equation}
The last step.
\end{proof}
\end{theorem}
\end{document}
